name: Rim Atmosphere
description: Presentation only (19i): the outer rim of the galaxy looks colder, darker and lonelier — cold colour grading, dark dust lanes, grainy murk over unexplored rim systems, derelict hulks, distant creature silhouettes, dimmer lights and a vignette deep in the rim. No gameplay change.
